'''Hangar One''' was the biggest [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] in the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] of [[Rothe Gate]]. It was not used for common [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Starship/Legends|ships]], but only for owner [[Nirama]]'s personal ship whenever he went to Rothe Gate in a surprise ''Central Administrative Review.''
